get_available_tools: get all available tools from config with optional group filtering, MCP inclusion, and vision model support
filter_host_bash_tools: filter out host-bash tools from the available tool list when sandbox mode is active
resolve_config_tools: resolve tool configuration entries into BaseTool instances using dynamic variable resolution
register_mcp_tools: register cached MCP tools into a deferred tool registry for tool search discovery
deduplicate_tool_names: deduplicate tools across config, built-in, MCP, and ACP sources keeping first occurrence by name
